target_scope: Unrestricted embedded branched surfaces in 3-manifolds admitting a nontrivial splitting to a homeomorphic copy, exactly Calegari Question7.1 (Agol). Finite sectors and a nonzero transverse-measure cone are hypotheses of the conditional algebraic route only; no ambient-isotopy, foliation, atoroidal, sutured, pseudo-Anosov or full-support hypothesis is silently added to the target.
strongest_partial: Known conditional finite-cone eigenray lemma and explicitly algebraic controls; geometric/source hypothesis and completeness-gap audit.
exact_gap: No legal embedded nontrivial splitting or compatible returned carrier is reconstructed from cone/operator data; no unrestricted reduction to pseudo-Anosov or atoroidal sutured depth-one veering hypotheses; no admissible prescribed-iterate complexes with a global unbounded-radius estimate; extension of the specified partial lamination L, if pursued, requires compatible preservation data beyond existence of some fully carried lamination.
